style: Classical Tamil Dravidian rock-cut and stone temple
key_structures: Shankari Devi Sanctum perched on Swami Rock cliff
Gopuram facing the Bay of Bengal
special_features: Spectacular location atop a 400-foot vertical cliff directly overlooking the azure Indian Ocean
Historic seat associated with sage Agastya and King Ravana's devotion to Lord Shiva
Ancient stone pillars retrieved from the ocean bed after 17th-century Portuguese demolition
renovation_history: Legendary 'Temple of a Thousand Pillars' destroyed by Portuguese in 1624 CE; murtis preserved secretly and retrieved from underwater; re-consecrated in 1952 and expanded in 2000s.
